farm_intro: Provide your farm information to help AgroReForm analyse agricultural conditions, costs, production and potential risk patterns.
farmer_id_message: Your AgroReForm Farmer ID will be generated automatically after registration.
cotton_focus_message: AgroReForm currently focuses on cotton farming in Punjab's Malwa region.
cost_description: Enter approximate cultivation expenses. These values help AgroReForm understand the economic conditions of your farming.
information_purpose_message: AgroReForm will use your information to generate farm-level analysis and decision-support insights.
submission_message: By submitting, your information will be processed for agricultural analysis.
farmer_footer_message: Agricultural Intelligence for Better Farming Decisions
hero_tagline: Better Data. Better Analysis. Better Decisions.
new_farmer_description: For farmers using AgroReForm for the first time.
existing_farmer_description: For farmers who already have an AgroReForm profile.
intelligence_description: For authorized officers, researchers and decision-makers.
footer_message: Building a smarter and more resilient agricultural future
analysis_intro: AgroReForm has analysed the agricultural information you provided and converted it into understandable financial and production indicators.
farm_summary_description: Basic information recorded for this analysis.
financial_indicators_description: Calculated from your recorded cultivation costs, production and selling price.
total_cultivation_cost_description: Combined recorded expenditure across cultivation cost categories.
estimated_revenue_description: Calculated from recorded production and average selling price.
estimated_net_return_description: Estimated revenue minus recorded cultivation cost.
production_description: Production recorded for the selected farming season.
cultivation_cost_review_description: Review how recorded expenditure is distributed across major cultivation activities.
analytical_indicators_description: Indicators generated from the information recorded for your farm.
cost_pressure_description: Recorded cultivation cost as a percentage of estimated recorded revenue.
pesticide_cost_share_description: Recorded pesticide expenditure as a percentage of total recorded cultivation cost.
cotton_farm_information_description: Additional agricultural information recorded during registration.
production_review_description: A simple view of production relative to the recorded cotton area.
reported_problem_description: The main problem reported during farm registration.
awareness_description: These indicators help you understand the relationship between your recorded cultivation costs, production and returns. They are intended to support informed decisions and do not replace agricultural experts or professional financial advice.
analysis_footer: AgroReForm — Agricultural Intelligence for Better Farming Decisions
financial_comparison_description: Visual comparison of recorded cultivation cost and estimated revenue.
cost_vs_revenue_description: Comparison of the two main financial values.
input_cost_distribution_description: How recorded cultivation expenditure is distributed across inputs.
production_trend_description: Historical trends become available when multiple seasons are recorded for the farm.
season_wise_farm_history_description: A meaningful line chart requires records from more than one farming season.
historical_data_not_available: Historical production data will appear here when multiple farming seasons are recorded for this farm.
cotton_area_share_description: Cotton area as a share of recorded farm area.
cost_per_area_description: Recorded cultivation cost relative to cotton area.
cultivation_cost_breakdown_description: Compare the recorded expenditure across major inputs.
evidence_based_observations_description: These observations are generated from the values recorded for your farm.
ai_ml_insight_layer_description: AgroReForm is designed to extend statistical analysis with machine-learning-based pattern identification.
personalized_farm_intelligence_descripti: The current page uses validated farm data and statistical indicators. Machine-learning insights should be generated only when sufficient validated historical records are available.
data_analysis_description: Farm-level cost, production and input patterns are analysed.
pattern_detection_description: Future ML models can identify recurring agricultural patterns from validated records.
farmer_awareness_description: Analytical findings can be converted into simple farmer-oriented awareness.
crop_problem_intro: Provide details about the problem observed in your cotton crop so that AgroReForm can help you understand possible causes and recommended actions.
crop_problem_disclaimer: This report records farmer-provided observations. It does not represent an expert-confirmed diagnosis.
